overall.verdict: The home total (dimmed cents, indigo Pay) and the Activity committed-frame sheet are the only shipping-grade moments; everywhere else the 1 px = $N bar language collapses into clipped full-width fades and captions. Stacked flows keep a tab bar and a stale 'Payment submitted' toast, Account's color legend lies about the bar, and the same −25 USDC has two receipts (PAID / Frame #42 vs proof / Frame #43).
priority_fixes: Draw every money bar on one 1 px = $N scale with an overflow tick; show the $25 pay as a hatch/delta on Hub One (Home, Pay, Account, both receipts) and change the default scale so 50–60k credit lines are not full-clip on a 390 px phone
Kill the sticky 'Payment submitted…' toast so it cannot sit inside the receipt or on Receive/Swap
Hide the tab bar on Pay/Receive/Swap/Account/sheets; ship one receipt (Activity-detail kv + proof + one frame number, indigo Done, no 2698 ms, no 'submitted' under PAID)

Make Account legend = bar = product tokens (purple collateral, amber credit, indigo receive, mint settled, hatch holds) and segment owed vs credit on the left half instead of painting the whole send side amber
Fix clipped chip rows (Activity 'Accou', Settings '$1000') with scroll-snap + 16 px peek; drop hub/sandbox chips; delete Home's $0 On-chain legend and Instant send/receive line
